Owning issue: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/397
Owner requested parallel implementation on 2026-09-30. Original issue intent follows; repository contracts and accepted authority remain governing.

## Summary

Republish a documentation corpus **from an approved documentation revision** as part of a post-merge workflow, with provenance and parity checks.

## Requested capability

- Trigger from an approved documentation revision, not from the product merge.
- Build incrementally where the manifest allows it: only the shards whose inputs changed.
- Emit provenance covering the documentation revision, the source revision, the builder, the tool versions, and the input digests. It must also include a parity report against the previous artifact (records added, retired, and changed).
- Output a republish change request body (through the connector contract) instead of publishing directly. A queued republish replaces the previous pending one instead of stacking.

## Acceptance

- Two builds from the same inputs are byte-identical.
- Parity reports catch a dropped shard.
- A republish never runs from an unapproved revision.


Part of #388.


## Owner-scheduled #397 preparation phase, 2026-10-02
Original human acceptance above is unchanged. Gate A reviewed plan SHA256 1adc37d422b826dd6b9b49e513d79cfc36fe61f1567faf558190533c3aac23a7 and contract d2523cc439afae592490ac70a33bcfb11f4cfc0c4ffa8926fc9a4ea8ba49e399. Root granted one serial initialization slot after actual CEM143 release2023. Native execution base/public branch base is 1fda1b94984245d0cd0ac0a6d17cc72572ce6619; sole clean source leaf /private/tmp/corvint-397-republish-current. Current phase is only initial context, proposed intent/registry preparation commit, then first freeze using that exact preparation commit as evidence BASE. No accepted-intent promotion, implementation, full gate, publication or completion. Complete future effects are recorded below as INCOMPLETE, not active authority; current prep effects are independently bounded and admitted through supported requested scope. Later code phase has no GENERATED_OUTPUT and needs separate root grant. Preserve full public1f-to-final diff provenance, native history, actual cancellation/debt, and same frozen key after first enrollment.
